label: def:categorical-transfer-matrix
title: Categorical transfer matrix
html:
Let \mathfrak{H}_p = [K_1, \ldots, K_n]_p \oplus \mathcal{L} be a hadron at a brane point p (localized hadron), and let \mathcal{S}_p be the exceptional divisor at p (exceptional divisor).

A categorical transfer matrix for \mathfrak{H}_p is the equivalence class

  \mathcal{T}(\mathfrak{H})
  = 
  \bigl[ T \bigr]_{\sim}
   \in 
  \mathrm{End}\bigl(H_n(R, q)\bigr) \big/ \sim

where T is any braiding operation on \mathfrak{H} (at either level) and the equivalence relation \sim identifies two operations T_1 \sim T_2 whenever they produce the same vertex volume:

  T_1 \sim T_2
  \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
  \hat{V}(T_1, q) = \hat{V}(T_2, q)
  \quad\text{as polynomials in } q.

This is well-defined because the vertex volume \hat{V}_i(q) depends only on the Markov trace of the Hecke-reduced element. It does not depend on the specific braid representative, the decomposition of \mathfrak{H} into constituents, or the path of braiding operations within \mathcal{S}_p.
